capabilities: (verb) Manage structured reading and career opportunities
(verb) Synchronize tasks across daily notes and projects
disambiguation: Not a generic task manager; it is designed to connect research ideas, projects, and daily work into a unified system.
extras: Local first design ensures data remains in Markdown files; currently in alpha status.
intentEvidence: A Markdown-first research and project operating system connecting ideas, projects, tasks, daily work, reading, and career opportunities.
motivation: The central idea is simple: Connect what you think about, what you build, what you read, what you work on, and where you want to go next.
problem: It addresses the difficulty of managing complex, interconnected research workflows, ideas, and projects within a standard note-taking environment.

relations.evidence: ResearchFlow supports importing career opportunities from a CSV export.

summary: A Markdown-first operating system that connects research ideas, projects, tasks, daily work, reading, and career opportunities within Obsidian.
